name: audio_speech
description: Agent Plan only: synthesize speech through the OpenSpeech HTTP TTS endpoint using the same Agent Plan API key and resource seed-tts-2.0. Supply native req_params with text, speaker and explicit audio_params.format. Collects the provider JSON audio chunks, requires the success terminator and returns combined audio_base64, audio_format and usage. Consumes quota. Standard Ark mode is not supported for this action.
